## LockingNotSupportedError class

Thrown when an operation requires exclusive locking that the active host does not provide. A host must implement `WasmHostPlatform.lockTrustManifest` to publish new trust approvals.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare class LockingNotSupportedError extends VaultError 
```
**Extends:** [VaultError](./wasm.vaulterror.md)
